entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned AGA for the State.

2. By means of the present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C., the applicant has sought for a suitable direction to the Court of Civil Judge (J.D.)/Fast Track Court (CAW), Jhansi, to pass an order of re-investigation in Case No.2127 of 2024 (State Vs. Juber Ahmad), arising out of Case Crime No.0024 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station- Mahila Thana, District- Jhansi.

entities.text: Case No.2127 of 2024 (State Vs. Juber Ahmad)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. It has been submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is informant of the aforesaid case and that police have not investigated the case properly.

The informant has also made allegations regarding termination of her pregnancy and criminal breach of trust but for these Khushnuma Mansoori vs State Of U.P. And Another on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/36721046/

entities.text: Khushnuma Mansoori vs State Of U.P. And Another on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 offences, no charge-sheet has been submitted by the police.
Referring to facts of the matter, it was submitted that a direction may be issued to the Court below to pass an order for re-investigation/further investigation in the aforesaid matter.

4. Learned AGA has opposed the application and submitted that applicant has not approached the concerned trial Court/ Magistrate for further investigation/re-investigation and thus, this application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is not maintainable.
5. I have considered the rival submissions and perused the record.

6. Considering submissions of learned counsel for the parties and facts of the matter, it is directed that in case applicant moves an application before the concerned Court/Magistrate for further investigation in accordance with law, the same shall be considered and decided expeditiously in accordance with law.
7. The instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is disposed of accordingly.
